_meta.provenance: AUTHORED FROM MODEL KNOWLEDGE - NOT FETCHED. Entries are real, well-known exploited CVEs; the JSON schema mirrors the CISA KEV feed shape, but dateAdded values and ransomware flags are from memory and unverified. Verify against the live feed on first sync.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: RDP pre-auth RCE (BlueKeep). Wormable, legacy-OS exposure remains the risk.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply updates per vendor instructions; disable exposed RDP.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: JNDI lookup injection via logged strings; ubiquitous footprint made it the year's defining RCE.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Update to patched Log4j2; search for downstream vulnerable dependencies.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Exchange SSRF enabling pre-auth proxying to backend and full email-store access when chained.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply March 2021 Exchange cumulative updates; investigate historical exploitation.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cryptographic flaw in MS-NRPC allows domain admin impersonation - direct route to domain takeover.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Enforce secure RPC; update domain controllers.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Class-loader manipulation via data binding in Spring MVC on JDK9+.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Update Spring Framework per vendor instructions.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS XE Web UI Privilege Escalation
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Unauthenticated account creation via the web UI management interface; mass-exploited at disclosure.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Disable web UI or update; audit for rogue local accounts.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Path Traversal
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Pre-auth arbitrary file read on VPN appliance, leading to credential and session theft.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade appliance per vendor instructions; check for compromise artifacts.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS Path Traversal Credential Exposure
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Pre-auth file read exposing VPN session credentials; heavily recycled in later intrusions.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade to patched FortiOS; rotate exposed credentials.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Path-traversal-in-auth allowing RMM admin creation; exploited in the wild within days of disclosure.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Update ScreenConnect immediately; audit operator accounts.

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Spooler RCE/LPE via driver operations; domain-class impact given spooler ubiquity.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply updates; disable spooler on servers not requiring it.
